prompts.asphalt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: seamless ground material for a detailed isometric city-building game at 128 pixels per tile. Generate a square ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN flat texture covering the whole canvas edge to edge. Dark neutral charcoal asphalt with very fine irregular aggregate, subtle wear and muted tonal variation. No cracks, potholes, stripes or road markings. Rich but restrained realistic painted game-art texture matching warm detailed architectural sprites, not a cartoon. Small-scale material detail readable after downsampling. Even neutral lighting, no directional shading, no highlight gradient, no perspective, no diamond outline, no bevel, no foundation edge, no objects or text. Opposite edges should join seamlessly. Opaque texture, no transparency.
